reason: 该插件的主要面向作用是增强 DeepSeek Harness Web 的聊天交互：在会话区选择文本后快速生成引用条目，并在发送新消息时自动将其作为引用块放入消息开头，属于会话工作流中的界面增强工具。依据 README 与 package 配置可确认其为纯前端 Web 插件入口（conversation composer dock 挂载）而非服务端或外部服务集成功能。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness Web 聊天界面中快速引用已对话内容：选中文本后生成引用条目并在发送追问时自动按 Markdown 引用块加入消息开头。
summaries.en: This plugin lets users quickly quote selected text in DeepSeek Harness Web by queuing snippets and automatically inserting them as Markdown blockquotes at the start of outgoing follow-up messages.

capabilities: Injects a floating action UI in the chat area when text is selected.
Caches selected conversation text as temporary quote chips above the composer with preview and delete controls.
Preprends selected quotes to outgoing messages as Markdown blockquote text.
Limits queued quote items and quote length per documented constraints.

reasons.code: Selection- and floating-button behavior for adding quotes is described in the README feature list.
Feature set (quote chip queue, preview, and message injection) is stated in repository description and usage documentation.
DSH web plugin wiring (client platform, bundle patch, and browser-targeted injection) is declared in package metadata.
